async def act(page):
    # Fill the status textbox with 'Out of Office'
    status_textbox = page.get_by_role('textbox', name="What's your status?")
    await status_textbox.fill('Out of Office')
    
    # Click the 'Set status' button to save the status

    await set_status_button.click()
    
    # Wait for any network requests to complete after setting the status
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
